sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Dual Control Racing is a simple yet challenging game that requires players to master the art of racing. The game's controls are responsive and intuitive, allowing players to focus on developing their driving skills without getting bogged down by complex mechanics. As you progress through the game, you will encounter various obstacles and challenges that will test your skills and reaction time. These obstacles include oil slicks, potholes, and other hazards that can slow you down or even send you crashing to the ground. To overcome these challenges, you will need to develop your reaction time and skills, as well as learn to navigate the track efficiently.

One of the key features of Dual Control Racing is its drifting mechanics. Drifting allows players to take sharp turns and maintain high speeds, making it a crucial skill for any serious player.
